summary: Non-destructive tests only change files in test subdirectories; run them in containers with --docker, select or exclude targets, increase verbosity with -v, and list targets with --list-targets.
questions: How do I run a single integration test target?
How do I list all integration test targets?
Should I run integration tests in Docker?

answer_card.title: Running non-destructive integration tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Run inside a container (`--docker`) to protect your system; `ansible-test integration --help` lists images.
```shell-session
ansible-test integration shippable/ --docker fedora
ansible-test integration --exclude git
ansible-test integration ping
ansible-test integration lineinfile -vvv
ansible-test integration --list-targets
```
